## Budget Utilization (Bu)

Compound field holding three plain numbers — budget, committed, actual — and deriving percent, band (healthy <70% / warning 70–95% / critical ≥95% / over >100%), and available. The embedded format is the dual-segment bar: actual solid, committed hatched, so "spent" and "promised" never blur. Domain-neutral: the consumer decides what counts as committed vs actual and keeps the numbers current.

### Example

The contained example mirrors the IT Hardware FY2026 Q1 budget: 120,000 / 18,400 / 12,100 → 25%, healthy.

### Non-goals

No currency handling (plain numbers; the consumer formats). No thresholds-as-arguments yet — the bands are fixed and documented.
